FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney speaks with Julie Norman, Associate Fellow with the Middle East and North Africa Programme at Chatham House and Director of UCL’s Israel-Palestine Initiative.

title: What the UK ban on goods from illegal Israeli settlements really means
description: Israel has announced that it’s shutting down the UK Consulate in occupied East Jerusalem after a new ban on its goods.

description: Bodycam video has captured the moment a Russian missile struck near police in Ukraine’s capital Kiev

title: Paul Adams: British-Israeli relations at lowest ebb in decades
description: Israel's response to London's trade ban with Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank shows how important this moment is.

title: They Went to Ukraine on the ‘Peace Express.’ Detours Are Likely Ahead.
description: The Trump administration had let the peace process enter such a freeze that a trip to Kyiv was just an initial step. Any new talks will happen alongside escalating fighting.

title: Israel Launches Deadly Strikes in Lebanon as Military Campaign Intensifies
description: The bombardment killed 11 people, Lebanese officials said, after days of attacks that have spurred worries that Israel is looking to push deeper into Lebanese territory.

title: U.S. Strikes Iranian Oil Tankers, Drawing Threat of Reprisal
description: American forces were said to have hit multiple vessels in response to Iranian attempts to hit a U.S. warship.

title: Dembélé, Kane and Mbappé headline shortlist for Ballon d’Or, Putellas leads women’s contenders
description: France Football magazine announced the nominees for the men’s and women’s Ballon d’Or, with winners to be announced on October 26 in London. Top contenders include Ousmane Dembélé, Harry Kane, and Kylian Mbappé, while Alexia Putellas leads the women’s field.

title: Saudi coordination, empowerment of Yemeni government to reshape balance of power
description: Political analysts suggest that Saudi Arabia is shifting from containment to a firmer deterrence strategy against Houthi attacks, emphasizing enhanced political and military coordination with Yemen's legitimate government.

title: Iran media says US missile struck Iranian tanker off Kharg Island
description: Local Iranian media has reported explosions on Kharg Island, an important site for the country’s oil exports. There are no further details currently available from the reports.

title: Nicaragua says Germany violates law in Gaza genocide case
description: THE HAGUE: Nicaragua told the International Court of Justice on Tuesday that Germany’s arms exports to Israel violates the 1948 Genocide Convention and humanitarian law and urged the court to allow its case against Berlin to continue. Germany suspended weapons exports ‌to Israel for a few months in 2025 but they have since resumed. title: Jordan and Palestine condemn island nation of Naoero for opening embassy in Jerusalem
description: LONDON: Jordan and the Palestinian Authority condemned the decision by the Republic of Naoero, an island nation in the South Pacific Ocean, to open an embassy in Jerusalem. The mission was inaugurated on Monday by Naoero’s vice president and foreign minister, Lionel Aingimea, and Israel’s foreign minister, Gideon Sa’ar. title: Lebanese army says rescued 22 migrants after boat sinks
description: The Lebanese military rescued 22 migrants after their boat, attempting illegal smuggling, broke down off Tripoli. Efforts continue to save remaining passengers.

title: UN condemns storming of Libya migrant aid centre
description: The United Nations has condemned the breach of one of its facilities in Tripoli where migrants were present, describing the acts as aggressive. Videos have shown people storming the International Organization for Migration’s premises.

title: UN condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia as fresh displacement wave deepens Yemen crisis
description: The UN condemned recent Houthi militia attacks on Saudi Arabia that targeted civilian and energy infrastructure, coinciding with escalating violence in Yemen that has displaced thousands of families and worsened the humanitarian crisis.
